MockApplyBehaviorConfig.description:
A single programmable apply outcome for the mock's ``behavior`` block.

``outcome`` maps to the four mock behaviors: ``applied``/``skipped`` are
``ApplyResult`` successes, ``error`` is a per-vacancy ``Err(BadRequestError)``,
and ``limit_exceeded`` is the stop signal ``Err(LimitExceededError)``.

Carries field metadata so the section's JSON schema renders a labeled,
enum-driven form (see client-contract.md §6.2).

message.description: Reason text attached to the scripted outcome (skip reason / error text).
message.title: Message

outcome.description: The apply outcome to script for a vacancy (manual-testing only).
outcome.title: Outcome

MockApplyBehaviorConfig.title: MockApplyBehaviorConfig

MockBehaviorConfig.description:
The mock's programmable behavior, read from its own config section.

Consumed only by :class:`MockClient` as a manual-testing seam — never by
core. ``per_vacancy`` keys are external ``str`` vacancy ids and override
``default_apply`` for those specific vacancies. ``captcha`` scripts an
offline captcha challenge (see :class:`MockCaptchaConfig`).

Carries field metadata so the section's JSON schema renders a labeled form
(see client-contract.md §6.2).

authorize_error.description: When set, the mock's ``authorize`` fails with this message (manual-testing only).
authorize_error.title: Authorize error

captcha.description: Optional offline captcha challenge to fire before an operation (manual-testing only).
captcha.title: Captcha (manual testing)

default_apply.description: Outcome applied to every vacancy not listed in ``per_vacancy``.
default_apply.title: Default apply outcome

MockBehaviorConfig.title: MockBehaviorConfig

MockCaptchaConfig.description:
Script a captcha challenge on one mock operation (manual-testing only).

When ``operation`` matches, the mock first routes its internal captcha
image through the injected :data:`~jobfucker.clients.base.CaptchaHandler`
(rendering/solving seam) ``attempts`` times before the operation proceeds.
On ``search`` the challenge fires **once per slice call** (not per native
page) — enough to exercise the human-solve path during a fetch. A handler
failure (unsolvable/EOF) collapses into ``Err(CaptchaSolvingError)`` —
exactly how an unsolvable real captcha surfaces. This lets a human test
CLI captcha rendering/handling offline without a live board.

attempts.description: How many captcha challenges to solve before the operation proceeds.
attempts.title: Solve attempts

operation.description: Which mock operation first requires solving a captcha.
operation.title: Captcha trigger operation

MockCaptchaConfig.title: MockCaptchaConfig

SearchWindow.description:
One search entry's fetch window/slice controls (all 0-based listing positions).

Single source for the window/slice vocabulary shared by the CLI flags and
the pipeline.yaml ``searches[].window`` block: the CLI projects its flags
here, a config entry validates its ``window`` block directly into this
model, and the whole validation matrix (page sizes, group exclusivity,
cap bounds) lives in exactly one place —
:func:`jobfucker.stages.fetch_plan.plan_fetch`, which consumes this model.
``first_page``/``page_size``/``take_pages`` define the fetch window
``W = [first_page*page_size, (first_page + take_pages)*page_size)``;
``from_``/``to``/``take`` further select a slice inside ``W``.

Config spelling uses the CLI flag words (``from`` is the yaml key of
``from_``); pydantic validates types here, never window semantics.

first_page.description: Zero-based first native page of the window.
first_page.title: First page

from.description: 0-based listing position to start the persisted slice at.
from.title: Slice from

page_size.description: Vacancies per native page; one of 20, 50, 100.
page_size.title: Page size

take.description: Vacancy count to persist; mutually exclusive with ``to``.
take.title: Slice take

take_pages.description: Native pages in the fetch window.
take_pages.title: Take pages

to.description: 0-based inclusive end position of the persisted slice; mutually exclusive with ``take``.
to.title: Slice to

SearchWindow.title: SearchWindow
